owner: Amazon Data Services India Pvt Ltd (AWS)
notes: EC/EMP on PARIVESH-adjacent EC portal for Data Center at Sy 190(P) Chandanvelly + 195(P) Hythabad, Shabad mandal, Ranga Reddy (file SIA/TG/INFRA2/503345/2024); ~33 acres, Rs 5,821 crore, phased; Telangana allocated 98 acres in Chandanvelly to Amazon (Jan 2025).
